profile.headline: Senior MES Engineer & IT Manager at Quanta USA Waymo
profile.summary:
have over 15years experience in MVC, C#, VB ASP.NET, JavaScript, SQL 2005 to 2014, Oracle Database Development, and also work with business intelligence Design in .Net Window ,WPF and WCF and Web product, I strong in application and Enterprise Development with ten experience trained in Enterprise system, Database architecture, window server Development and Web base architectures with Object-Oriented design, I am also work with QA Testing. I graduated with a Science degree in Computer Science and Computer Engineering from California State University, East Bay in September, 2006. and Also earning Decision Analysis risk management certificate in Stanford University,  I own mcts microsoft sharepoint 2010 application development certification and mcts microsoft sql server 2008 business intelligence development and maintenance certification in 2011 I this should prove valuable in increasing at your company Insurance Inspections, and team-oriented volume.

Frameworks: Saas, Platforms, Paas: .Microsoft .Net, SalesForce MVC (Apex, VisualForce), SharePoint, J2EE, J2SE, LAMP, Unix, Amazon Cloud
•	Languages: Java, ASP.net  C#, C/C++, VBA, Visual Basic
•	Web Front End - HTML, CSS, HTML5, JavaScript, VBScript, JSON, AJAX, D3.js, AngularJS, Esri ArcGIS geospatial mapping
•	Database, Data Warehouse:  MySQL, MS SQL Servers (SSRS, SSIS), Oracle, Hadoop, Hive

positions.title: Sr MES Engineer & IT Manager
positions.description:
Worked on the manufacturing Data system (MES,MRB,RMA,QA)Software Development for whole production line in each process, Responsible for Data Management and Develop  software tools process/logics in both C#, Python, API, SOAP,SAP and SQL environment.
● Worked with relational databases and utilize SQL,C#, Python, and SOAP to transform the data in proper format or structure for optimizing list processing purposes and load final files into the final target database/server used by the List Selection DB Marketing Team
● Database queries and data integration to support integrating suppression criteria, audience targeting model criteria, deployment, data governance and controls across the organization's database used for acquisition and manufacturing Data
● Undertook data or record collection, data cleansing and coding, data aggregation and validation using SQL,SAP or Excel
● Develops data execution tool and recording tool for Users in assembly Line and Develop application UX between Machine and tester, OP
● Develops monitoring and Data Reporting tool to support PM,ME, EE on track in product status and project performance
● MES, RMA, MRB, QCA, Warehouse system owner, working on system software/Database architect, Design, analysis, maintenance, Management and Training
positions.insights: Skills: MES · Data Modeling · SAP ERP · Back-End Web Development · Business Intelligence Tools · Manufacturing Automation · Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) · Infor Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) · Automotive Manufacturing · Torque · DevOps · .NET Framework · Front-End Development
